description: start_sieve_admin_server returns Err at startup if the configured listen address is non-loopback and no bearer token is configured. This is the correct fail-closed posture: rather than starting an unprotected admin API on a public interface, the process refuses to start. The check is done at startup, not at request time, so there is no race window.
title: smtp: sieve_admin.rs fail-closed on non-loopback without bearer token
